title: Coverlet (VSTest collector) + ReportGenerator code coverage

rules.rule: Collect coverage with the collector only: `dotnet test --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" --settings coverlet.runsettings`. Never add `coverlet.msbuild` next to `coverlet.collector`, and do not use `/p:CollectCoverage=true` or other `/p:Coverlet*` properties, because those belong to the msbuild driver this repo does not reference.
rules.why: The coverlet README says to reference collector OR msbuild in a test project, never both. Without coverlet.msbuild the `/p:` properties are ignored and the run silently writes no report. With both packages the test DLL is instrumented twice and the numbers become unreliable.

rules.rule: Run coverage on one TFM (`-f net8.0`) and write it to a fresh, empty `--results-directory` on every run. ReportGenerator's `-reports` glob must never see a TFM or run you did not mean to merge.
rules.why: VSTest writes each run's coverage.cobertura.xml into a new random GUID folder, and ReportGenerator merges every file the glob matches. Omitting `-f` merges nine TFMs: net461 compiles the TRANSLOADIT_NEWTONSOFT branch and the others compile System.Text.Json, so different code paths get blended into one percentage. Reusing `$OUT` merges stale runs and inflates coverage of code you have since changed.

rules.rule: Measure the configuration you ship: run coverage with `-c Release`, the build CI tests and NuGet packs, which sets ContinuousIntegrationBuild and Deterministic on the library. The collector supports deterministic builds. Its build targets write `CoverletSourceRootsMapping_<TestAssemblyName>` into the test output folder, which maps the PDB's `/_/` source paths back to local paths. Verify each Release coverage run in two ways: `tests/Transloadit.Tests/bin/Release/net8.0/CoverletSourceRootsMapping_Transloadit.Tests` exists, and the cobertura `filename` attributes are local paths, not `/_/...`. Leave `DeterministicReport` off for local reports.
rules.why: Release sets ContinuousIntegrationBuild=true, so the library PDB holds deterministic `/_/` paths. If the mapping file is missing, coverlet's known issue applies: NaN coverage and the module missing from the instrumented list. Checking both signals catches that instead of trusting an empty report. DeterministicReport=true writes `/_/` filenames and an empty `<sources/>`, so ReportGenerator cannot show source in the HTML report.
rules.repoConvention: Known deviation: the coverage skill runs in the default Debug configuration (.claude/skills/coverage/SKILL.md step 2 passes no `-c`) to avoid an unverified deterministic-path effect. CI meanwhile tests Release (.github/workflows/tests.yml). Fix: add `-c Release` to the skill's dotnet test command and add the two checks above. Do a one-off run first: `dotnet test tests/Transloadit.Tests/Transloadit.Tests.csproj -c Release -f net8.0 --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" --settings coverlet.runsettings`, then confirm the mapping file exists and that the cobertura filenames are local paths.

rules.rule: Select coverage tests by excluding the credentialed live tests, not by listing the offline ones: `--filter "FullyQualifiedName!~Tests.Api&FullyQualifiedName!~AssemblyTrackerTests"`. Every TestBase-derived class lives under Tests/Api, plus AssemblyTrackerTests. Put any new live test in Tests/Api so this exclusion keeps working.
rules.why: An allow-list (`FullyQualifiedName~A|FullyQualifiedName~B|...`) silently drops every offline test whose name matches no alternative, and ProjectTests is already dropped. Its code then reads as untested, and coverage deltas after adding tests show nothing. An exclusion list fails safe: new offline tests count automatically.
rules.repoConvention: Known deviation: the coverage skill's --filter is an allow-list (Tests.Unit, Tests.Models, Tests.Constants, SignatureTests, SerializationDefaultsTests, NewRobotsTests) and misses ProjectTests (.claude/skills/coverage/SKILL.md step 2). Fix: replace it with `FullyQualifiedName!~Tests.Api&FullyQualifiedName!~AssemblyTrackerTests` (escape `!` in POSIX shells). Do a one-off check that the run is green without appsettings.Tests.json and that its test count is at least the allow-list's.

rules.rule: Put coverage exclusions in coverlet.runsettings as `[Assembly]Type` filters in `<Exclude>`, attributes in `<ExcludeByAttribute>` or globs in `<ExcludeByFile>`. Do not exclude auth or serialization code (SignatureUtilities, serializers, converters) to raise the numbers.
rules.why: User filters are appended to the built-in defaults (coverlet.*, xunit.*, Microsoft.Testing.*, Microsoft.VisualStudio.TestPlatform.*), and `[ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]` is always honoured. An exclusion placed on the signature or serializer code hides exactly the auth and data-integrity paths this target's stakes depend on.

rules.rule: Keep coverlet.collector on a supported, fixed release that matches the test TFMs. While the test project targets net461 and net462, use 6.0.4, the last 6.x and still supporting .NET Framework 4.6.1. Once the .NET Framework TFMs are net472 or later only, use 10.1.0 or later together with Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 17.12.0 or later. Never use 8.0.0 to 10.0.x when .NET Framework coverage matters. Keep the ReportGenerator local tool on the latest 5.5.x.
rules.why: 6.0.1 to 6.0.4 fixed ExcludeFromCodeCoverage handling, record coverage, hanging tests and empty reports when include and exclude filters were combined. 8.0.0 raised the minimum to .NET 8 and .NET Framework 4.7.2. From 8.0.0 until the 10.1.0 fix, coverage on .NET Framework was silently zero.
rules.repoConvention: Known deviation: coverlet.collector is pinned to 6.0.0 (tests/Transloadit.Tests/Transloadit.Tests.csproj) and ReportGenerator to 5.5.10 (.config/dotnet-tools.json). Fix: bump the collector to 6.0.4 and ReportGenerator to 5.5.12 now. Move to collector 10.1.0 or later and Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 17.12.0 or later only if net461/net462 leave the test TFMs. Do a one-off check after the bump: the net8.0 coverage summary still lists the Transloadit assembly with non-zero coverage.

rules.rule: While the collector is pinned below 6.0.4, do not add an `<Include>` filter next to the existing `<Exclude>`. Narrow coverage with `<Exclude>` only, or upgrade to 6.0.4 or later first.
rules.why: 6.0.4 fixed reports that came out empty when include and exclude filters were combined, so on 6.0.0 adding `<Include>[Transloadit]*</Include>` can produce an empty report.

rules.rule: Keep `UseSourceLink` false in coverlet.runsettings, even though the library references Microsoft.SourceLink.GitHub.
rules.why: With UseSourceLink=true the report filenames become SourceLink URIs instead of file-system paths. ReportGenerator then cannot read local source for the HTML view, and the report points at remote commits instead of the working tree under test.

rules.rule: If coverage is ever collected on net461, pass `-- RunConfiguration.DisableAppDomain=true`.
rules.why: The library is strong-name signed. On .NET Framework 4.6.1, instrumentation combined with xUnit app domains fails the tests with a strong-name verification FileLoadException.

rules.rule: Keep `dotnet test` in VSTest mode while coverage depends on coverlet.collector. Before moving the test project to Microsoft.Testing.Platform (xunit.v3 runner, or global.json `test.runner` = Microsoft.Testing.Platform on the .NET 10 SDK), replace the collector with `coverlet.MTP` (`--coverlet --coverlet-output-format cobertura`, with runsettings filters rewritten as `--coverlet-exclude` and similar) or with Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage (`--coverage --coverage-output-format cobertura`).
rules.why: coverlet.collector and coverlet.msbuild rely on VSTest data collectors and cannot run under MTP, so `--collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"` stops producing a report. runsettings DataCollector configuration does not carry over to MTP. Microsoft's extension writes a binary `.coverage` file by default, which the skill's reportgenerator step cannot read.
where: not used here yet (no global.json; xunit 2.5.3 + xunit.runner.visualstudio in tests/Transloadit.Tests/Transloadit.Tests.csproj)

rules.rule: Do not switch to the built-in VSTest collector (`--collect "Code Coverage"`, Microsoft.CodeCoverage) without also adding a `dotnet-coverage` conversion step and re-checking test-assembly inclusion.
rules.why: The built-in collector writes a binary .coverage file that must be converted before a report can be generated. Under VSTest, Microsoft's coverage includes the test assembly by default (the default became false only in the MTP extension), so the figures would mix in Transloadit.Tests.

bugCategories.name: coverage-filter-drift
bugCategories.lookFor: A coverage --filter written as an allow-list. With the current allow-list, any offline test class outside Tests.Unit, Tests.Models, Tests.Constants and the three named classes is missed, and ProjectTests already is. Also look for a new live, TestBase-derived test placed outside Tests/Api, which the recommended exclusion filter would not skip.
bugCategories.failure: An allow-list leaves offline tests out of the report, so their code reads as untested. A live test outside Tests/Api makes the credential-free coverage run throw in TestBase and fail.

bugCategories.name: merged-stale-or-cross-tfm-reports
bugCategories.lookFor: A ReportGenerator `-reports` glob over a results directory that was not emptied first, or a `dotnet test --collect` without `-f`.
bugCategories.failure: Coverage percentages are inflated or blended across Newtonsoft and System.Text.Json builds, so an untested branch reads as covered.

bugCategories.name: silent-zero-coverage
bugCategories.lookFor: A report at 0% or NaN, or one missing the Transloadit module. Likely causes: collector 8.0.0 to 10.0.x on a .NET Framework TFM, a Release or deterministic build without the CoverletSourceRootsMapping file, or Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk below 17.7 (the in-proc collector is not loaded).
bugCategories.failure: The test run is green but the coverage report is empty or wrong, and decisions about what to test are made on false data.

bugCategories.name: empty-report-include-exclude
bugCategories.lookFor: `<Include>` added to coverlet.runsettings alongside `<Exclude>` while the collector is pinned below 6.0.4.
bugCategories.failure: The cobertura report has no packages.

bugCategories.name: exclusion-hides-critical-code
bugCategories.lookFor: New `[ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]`, ExcludeByFile globs or `[Transloadit]...` Exclude filters touching Utilities/SignatureUtilities, Serialization or the client request pipeline.
bugCategories.failure: Signature and serialization paths (auth and data-integrity stakes) drop out of the report, so untested auth code reads as fully covered.

testing.layers: Coverage measures the xUnit suite on net8.0. The offline tests are everything except Tests/Api and AssemblyTrackerTests, and they give the credential-free baseline. Adding the live tests raises service-method coverage but needs appsettings.Tests.json. Coverage proves code was executed, not that it was asserted.
commands: dotnet test tests/Transloadit.Tests/Transloadit.Tests.csproj -c Release -f net8.0 --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" --settings coverlet.runsettings --results-directory "$OUT" --filter "FullyQualifiedName!~Tests.Api&FullyQualifiedName!~AssemblyTrackerTests"
traps: The coverage skill today still uses Debug and an allow-list filter. See the two known-deviation rules before trusting its numbers.
VSTest writes into a random GUID folder per run, so clear $OUT before each run or the glob merges old reports.
In POSIX shells, escape `!` in the exclusion filter (`\!~`) or single-quote it.
ReportGenerator 5.5.x requires the .NET 8/9/10 runtime (or .NET Framework 4.7). The local tool has rollForward false.
Without appsettings.Tests.json, any TestBase-derived class that the filter does not exclude throws at construction.

security.note: No published security advisories exist for coverlet, and nuget.org shows no vulnerability flag for coverlet.collector or dotnet-reportgenerator-globaltool. Reports (HTML especially) embed the library source and local paths: keep them in scratch, which .gitignore partly covers (coverage*.xml), and do not attach them to public CI artefacts.

pins: coverlet.collector 6.0.0 in tests/Transloadit.Tests/Transloadit.Tests.csproj. Recommended: 6.0.4 while net461/net462 remain; 10.1.0 or later once they are gone. Latest is 10.1.0.
dotnet-reportgenerator-globaltool 5.5.10 in .config/dotnet-tools.json. Recommended: 5.5.12, the latest; no breaking changes listed for 5.5.11 or 5.5.12.
lockStep: Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk (17.8.0 here): the README lists 17.12.0 or later for current collector versions, and the master VSTest doc sample uses 18.4.0
Test TargetFrameworks: collector 8.0.0 and later supports only .NET 8 or later and .NET Framework 4.7.2 or later (net461/net462 drop out)
.NET SDK 8.0.x or later is needed for collector 8.0.0 and later
A test-platform move to MTP means replacing coverlet.collector with coverlet.MTP or Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage
